description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including signup and login, using FastAPI. It handles user creation, password hashing, JWT token generation, and credential validation.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object used to define API routes for authentication.

methods.name: AuthResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user authentication by verifying credentials and returning a JWT token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
